commentary.text: 90+7' Matthias Jollenbeck is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' A yellow card for a tackle by Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt). Matthias Jollenbeck doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+6' Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Alexander Nubel comes off his line to intercept.
90+5' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
90+4' Matthias Jollenbeck shows a yellow card to Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+3' Here is a change. Maximilian Mittelstadt is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).
90+3' That will be all from Jamie Leweling who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Lorenz Assignon (VfB Stuttgart).
90+1' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. Stuttgart force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
87' 3 - 2 Goal! Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) scores after an assist by Josha Vagnoman that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 3:2.
85' Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Kaua Santos is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
83' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Kaua Santos makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
82' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.

80' 2 - 2 GOAL! Superb work from Mahmoud Dahoud, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt), who beats Alexander Nubel with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
80' The resulting corner from Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) comes to nothing.
80' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner but it's cleared. Stuttgart have a corner.
79' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. The referee blows his whistle, Stuttgart are awarded a corner kick.
78' Matthias Jollenbeck blows his whistle after Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
77' Substitution. Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Ritsu Doan.
77' Dino Toppmoller decides to make a substitution. Ellyes Skhiri will be replaced by Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt).
77' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
75' The attendance is 59500.
75' Badredine Bouanani (VfB Stuttgart) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chris Fuhrich.
74' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Jeff Chabot and he is replaced by Finn Jeltsch (VfB Stuttgart).
73' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
72' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
71' A first-time shot by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
70' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
67' Dino Toppmoller prepares a substitution. Ansgar Knauff is replaced by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
66' We are about to witness a substitution. Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replacing Oscar Hojlund.
66' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
66' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

66' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the left post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save. Corner kick. Stuttgart will have an opportunity.
64' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to a loose ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot on goal, but the effort lacks accuracy and flies high over the bar.
62' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was too forceful with his tackle and Matthias Jollenbeck interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
60' A sweet pass inside the box gives Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
59' Substitution. Nikolas Nartey (VfB Stuttgart) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ermedin Demirovic walks off.
58' OFF THE WOODWORK! Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
58' CHANCE! Deniz Undav finds Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
56' Today's referee Matthias Jollenbeck rightly decides to book Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) for his harsh tackle.
56' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
55' Flag goes up against Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
53' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
51' A great solo run by Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the top of the net was easily caught by Alexander Nubel.
50' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
49' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
47' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' Eintracht Frankfurt exchange some short passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes completely.

45+2' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Kaua Santos thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
45+1' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Eintracht Frankfurt get a corner.
43' The game is interrupted now, Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
43' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
41' The linesman raises his flag. Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is adjudged offside.
40' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

40' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.

39' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Kaua Santos. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Stuttgart will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
37' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Kaua Santos as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
35' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Josha Vagnoman tees up Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Kaua Santos.
34' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

34' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Stuttgart have been awarded a corner kick.
33' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

33' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner.
32' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

32' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Stuttgart are going to take it.

31' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Kaua Santos guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
29' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Kaua Santos makes a huge mistake and Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
27' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kaua Santos, who smothers the ball.
26' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.

25' What an opportunity! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
23' The referee blows his whistle as Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in his challenge.
22' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Matthias Jollenbeck stops the game and makes a call.
21' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
20' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) suffers an injury and Jean-Matteo Bahoya comes on.
19' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
17' Stuttgart control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
15' Looks like Younes Ebnoutalib (Eintracht Frankfurt) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
14' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
13' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) and Oscar Hojlund attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
11' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

10' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Good work from Stuttgart as they win a corner.
9' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Matthias Jollenbeck ignores the protests.
8' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
6' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.

5' 0 - 1 Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) jumped highest inside the box to meet a perfectly executed corner kick by Ritsu Doan. His header was precise and ended up inside the left post, leaving the goalkeeper flapping in the wind. The score is 0:1.
4' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
4' Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Eintracht Frankfurt.
3' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to send a defence-splitting pass in order to find free space for his teammate.
2' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
